evidence.quote: This degree programme does not charge any tuition fees.

All international applicants with international university entrance qualifications (e.g. secondary level education qualifications) must also apply via uni-assist (you can have your documents reviewed by uni-assist at any time throughout the year).
The application period runs from May 15th until July 15th every year.
Letter of motivation – maximum two A4 pages
Documents not issued in German or English must be translated by a certified translator into either German or English.

notes: Tuition: The programme page states 'No tuition fees' and the DAAD page states 'This degree programme does not charge any tuition fees.' The general TUM page says international non-EU students usually pay 2,000 or 3,000 EUR per semester for bachelor's programmes, but this programme-specific statement takes precedence. Semester contribution of 97.00 EUR applies (Heilbronn campus). APS certificate is not required for Moroccan applicants (only China, Vietnam, India).
